title: Fabrication and characterization of custard apple seed starch/ corn starch bio-nanocomposite films immobilized with chitosan nanoparticles and pomegranate peel powder for extending the shelf life of Litchi chinensis fruit
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00721F, Paper

Sachin P. Shinde, Swapnali S. Bhole, Namita S. Patil, Gurunath V. Mote, Vikramsinh M. Ingale
A bio-nanocomposite packaging film was developed from custard apple seed starch incorporating varying concentrations of chitosan nanoparticles with corn starch, carrageenan, guar gum, and pomegranate peel powder.
